text: In March 2023 the investor group led by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo, together with investment affiliates of J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital, completed its previously announced acquisition of Atlas Air Worldwide.

source.name: Atlas Air Worldwide – Investor group led by Apollo, together with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital, completes acquisition of Atlas Air Worldwide
source.quote: today announced that the investor group led by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo (NYSE: APO), together with investment affiliates of J.F. Lehman & Company (“J.F. Lehman”) and Hill City Capital (“Hill City”), has completed its previously announced acquisition of the Company
